ModMetadata.Name: Lattice
ModMetadata.Author: XCeled
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]The ghost core library other Stationeers mods build on[/h1] Lattice holds planned structures, called ghosts: see-through outlines of frames, walls, pipes and anything else, placed where you mean to build them. It does nothing on its own. Install it when a mod you use asks for it, such as a building planner, a builder or an agent tool. Mod authors get one shared, tested system for plans instead of writing their own.
[hr][/hr] [h2]Features[/h2] [list] [*][b]Plans of ghosts.[/b] Build, remove, swap, paint and finish structures as ghosts, grouped in named plans, as many per world as you like. [*][b]Placement checks.[/b] Every ghost is checked against the game's own placement rules; a ghost that cannot be built says why. [*][b]Build order.[/b] What has to stand before what, so a plan goes up in an order that holds together. [*][b]Steps and materials.[/b] The build steps of every ghost and the materials they need: a shopping list for a plan. [*][b]Previews.[/b] What a change would do before it is made, such as a room it opens or the gas a removed pipe lets out. [*][b]Move, turn, mirror and copy.[/b] Whole plans or parts of them, and templates to place again. [*][b]Done tracking.[/b] Build a piece where its ghost stands and the ghost is marked done. [*][b]Drawing.[/b] Ghosts are drawn in the world with Lattice's own shaders: colours, highlights, blinking errors and labels. Other mods add looks of their own. [*][b]Saving.[/b] Plans are kept per world, beside the saves, never inside one. [*][b]Multiplayer.[/b] The host decides; every player sees the host's plans as they change. [*][b]Light on the frame.[/b] Long work is spread over frames, so a large base stays smooth. [/list]
[hr][/hr] [h2]Removing it[/h2] Lattice keeps plans in a [i]lattice[/i] folder beside the game's saves, never inside a save, so your saves load the same without it. Removing it hides every ghost, and the mods that need it cannot work without it. Put it back and the plans come back. Delete that folder to drop them for good.
[hr][/hr] [h2]Good to know[/h2] [list] [*]Each save loads the plans as they were when it was written. [*]Multiplayer: the host and every player need Lattice at the same version. A dedicated server keeps and saves plans without drawing them. [*]After a game update, a part of Lattice that relies on game code that changed turns itself off and says so in the log; the rest keeps working. [*]Mod authors: the guides to building on Lattice are in the repository's [i]docs[/i] folder (link below). [/list]
[hr][/hr] [b]Requires[/b] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url]
[b]Source, issues, the full readme and the mod author guides:[/b] [url=https://github.com/altmank/Stationeers-Lattice]github.com/altmank/Stationeers-Lattice[/url]
Developed with the use of generative AI, and tokens aren't free. Buy me a coffee: [url=https://ko-fi.com/xceled]ko-fi.com/xceled[/url]
ModMetadata.ChangeLog:
v0.22.6 - Fixed: chute runs follow their flow from start to end: a chute junction's output faces on along the run, and a branch joins as an input.
v0.22.5 - Fixed: a chute run or route can branch: it lays a chute junction where a T is needed.
v0.22.4 - Added: mods can read Lattice's patch number, so they can tell which small additions are there.
v0.22.3 - Fixed: a wall, window, floor or door planned on a face but turned to face along it now shows as off-snap, as the game never builds it that way.
v0.22.2 - Fixed: walls, windows, floors and doors planned on a face (a wall against a ceiling) no longer show as off-snap; one planned at a cell centre now does, as the game never builds it there.
v0.22.1 - Added: mods can ask how the game places each piece: in a cell, on a face, or mounted on a face.
v0.22.0 - Added: builder mods (docks, drones) can say where they work, how they are doing and what they can supply, and every player sees it. - Added: a plan can be assigned to several builders at once, each answering whether it takes it on; how much each built is counted and kept in the save. - Added: plans have a colour any mod can show. - Changed: mods hear about every claim a builder takes or lets go, not only its reports.
v0.21.1 - Fixed: after a plan is caught up or reopened, players already in the game see the same progress as the host.
v0.21.0 - Added: mods can ask which ways the game lets you turn each piece. - Changed: a ghost turned a way the game does not let you build that piece is now marked as failing; plans made before may show new failures. - Changed: drawn runs, routes and moved or turned ghosts keep to the turns the game allows.
v0.20.0 - Changed: a merge step names the kit stack the builder holds; a bill lists what a merge holds and gets back. - Changed: paint steps name the spray can, and name and setting steps the labeller; bills count the cans and the labeller. - Fixed: a builder carrying out a merge that costs no extra kit now has the kit in hand, so the merge no longer fails. - Fixed: Lattice reads the game's pieces before a world starts, a little each frame, so a big base can no longer get a wrong or failing piece lookup while it is being checked.
v0.19.1 - Fixed: a player who joins a game after work was built now sees each plan's progress as the host does. - Fixed: after a big plan, placing and drawing runs no longer stall: a small preview answers at once instead of waiting for the whole plan's checks. - Fixed: a cable, pipe or chute route now goes around a planned device (such as a stacker) instead of through it.
v0.19.0 - Added: builder mods can say why a ghost waits (needs items, out of reach, no power, blocked) in the same words as every other builder. - Added: mods can show any item's name in the player's language, and place a piece at a cell's exact point and turn.
v0.18.0 - Added: pieces the game snaps to frame centres, such as the gas and liquid rocket engines and umbilicals, are planned only where the game builds them; a ghost elsewhere is marked as failing. - Added: mods can ask which cells a piece fills, to rest a tank or device on a frame.
v0.17.1 - Fixed: a cable or pipe run drawn through a built device now shows the device's cell as blocked.
v0.17.0 - Added: logged reasons now show their details. - Fixed: a multiplayer client that missed one change from the host fell out of step for the rest of the session, so built pieces kept their ghosts. It now asks the host for the whole plan again and catches up. - Fixed: one mod's failing event handler no longer keeps the others, and multiplayer sync, from a change. - Fixed: on a client, modules that only run on the host now say so in the log instead of looking missing.
v0.16.0 - A preview of several commands sent together now shows the run reports of the runs and routes among them.
v0.15.0 - Mods can select a whole planned cable, pipe or chute network from one of its pieces, through junctions.
v0.14.1 - A run that leaves the end of a line turns the end piece into a corner instead of a tee with an open stub; chute runs no longer fail there.
v0.14.0 - Routes can keep off existing lines, joining them only at their ends. - A drawn run can be checked against the route rules and shows the first cell that breaks one.
v0.13.1 - Lattice enabled twice, Workshop and local, now runs once and says which copy.
v0.13.0 - Planned pieces can be swapped in place: a planned cable run becomes heavy cable and keeps its labels, colours and groups. - Swapping a built piece that already has a planned swap now changes that planned swap instead of replacing it.
v0.12.1 - A route that cannot be found now says where its search stopped and what kept it out.
v0.12.0 - Runs and routes can end on a built device's port. - Routes can be pinned through chosen cells. - One highlight can light a whole network, ghosts and built pieces together.
v0.11.0 - Seeing ghosts through walls is stronger at full strength, and a look can set how strongly the hidden part shows.
v0.10.5 - Devices planned on a planned wall or frame now wait for it instead of being refused.
v0.10.4 - Ghosts can now show their ports, open ends, flow arrows and what they wait for. - Hiding ghosts beyond the cut-away plane now works in game.
v0.10.3 - Selecting part of a large base is now fast: a box looks only at the structures it covers.
v0.10.2 - Mods that limit who may see a plan now also hide it from the finished-plans list. - For mod authors: test stubs that keep compiling when Lattice adds to its interfaces.
v0.10.1 - Players on a client see who works on which ghost: executors' claims and status, with their looks and events, reach every client.
v0.10.0 - Templates can be saved and shared as text, and placed into an existing plan. - Mods that limit who may change a plan can now see which plan a request is for.
v0.9.0 - Routes can go up or across first, keep to frames and walls, carry branches with tees, and lay single pieces or match the grade. - Planners can split a long straight into single pieces, and lay walls, windows and floors in their own plane.
v0.8.1 - A refused move, turn or mirror names exactly the ghosts in the way, so planners can retry without them.
v0.8.0 - Mods can read every placed piece's ports (ghosts included), so tools can plan pipe and cable runs between ghosts without building anything. - Runs and routes can end at a ghost's port. - Several runs placed together now join where they meet instead of replacing each other.
v0.7.1 - Validation stops asking the game about ghosts that are already gone, so a finished plan settles faster on a large base.
v0.7.0 - Windows are their own family, under walls: a see-through face that seals air once built. Style rules for walls still cover windows; mods can now style windows alone. Floor gratings stay walls. - Style rules can match face pieces by how they lie: flat (floors, ceilings) or upright. - The mod author guides are on GitHub (link above).
